topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Masters and mistresses, hear my plea. The thatch on my roof is thin, and the wind whispers through the gaps, chilling my bones. The lord's taxes grow heavier with each passing year, as if the earth itself conspires to press more weight upon my shoulders. Now, I hear the villagers speak of a new curse – the landlord sells the very ground beneath our feet, piece by piece, to strangers who see our homes as nothing but coins in their purses. How are we to till the soil, to sow and reap, if the land is no longer ours to walk? The saints have mercy, for I fear the winter grows long and harsh.
